notes: Perfect-recruitment ending: Aditya's cabin. 'shared' branch if Alice sent the hired names to the unknown sender, otherwise 'kept_quiet'.

summon.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
summon.text: Come up to my cabin, Alice. Now.

common.text: Floor 31. Aditya's cabin. He is not angry. That is worse.

common.speaker: ADITYA
common.text: Sit down, Alice. I want to share something with you.

common.speaker: ADITYA
common.text: A lot of people in this company have gone missing. Recruiters, mostly. People who sat in your chair.

common.speaker: ADITYA
common.text: Ashgrove is one of the top companies in this country. As its CEO, my job is to protect information.

shared.speaker: ADITYA
shared.text: Which is why I know you sent those names in an email tonight.

shared.speaker: ADITYA
shared.text: It is very hard for me to work with someone like that, Alice.

shared.speaker: ALICE
shared.text: Sir, please — I didn't know who it was. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. Please.

kept_quiet.speaker: ADITYA
kept_quiet.text: Someone asked you for those names tonight. You said nothing.

kept_quiet.speaker: ADITYA
kept_quiet.text: Good. Loyalty is rarer than talent. Go home, Alice. Tomorrow there will be more files.

missing_poster.title: MISSING
missing_poster.name: ALICE
missing_poster.footer: Anyone with information, contact Ashgrove Security. Do not approach Floor 13 after dark.

final_email_shared.subject: re: the names
final_email_shared.body:
Hi Alice,

Don't share the details with me.

It's your boss.

final_email_quiet.subject: (no subject)
final_email_quiet.body:
Alice, please reply to me.

Please.
